entities.name: Patron of the Kitsune
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa active during the Kami War, the great Patron Kami of the Kitsune, appearing as a giant white beast with eight arms ending in black clawed hands.

entities.name: Kitsune
entities.description: The people for whom the Patron of the Kitsune is patron kami and whom it eats as offerings.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which the kami was active.

events.summary: The Patron of the Kitsune eats Kitsune as offerings.
events.quote: It is known to eat Kitsune as offerings.

relations.note: Great Patron Kami of the Kitsune.
relations.quote: great Patron Kami of the Kitsune
